gen-unifrakturmaguntia-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads crisp and modern, its strokes never thickening or thinning. UnifrakturMaguntia sits against it as dark, clustered gothic, and that gap between ornate and stripped-back is the whole point.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-inter: Clustered, lofty gothic letters mark UnifrakturMaguntia out at once. Inter, a sans with big open counters and a smooth tube-like line, does the quiet work of reading while the heading handles the drama.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-mulish: Gothic meets friendly. UnifrakturMaguntia brings tight, towering letters that command attention, while Mulish, a sans-serif cut to a single line width, simply lets the words flow with its large x-height.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-poppins: Poppins reads smooth and loose, its curves drawn from one gauge of tubing with no thick-thin flicker. And UnifrakturMaguntia stays up top as the dark gothic voice, so give the body some extra size.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-rubik: Tight, clustered gothic letters give UnifrakturMaguntia its heavy presence. Rubik, a plain sans with soft, big lowercase and open rounds, keeps a longer passage friendly and easy on the eye.
gen-zilla-slab-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and polished, with curves that open wide and a tempered contrast in its line. Zilla Slab stands above it, sturdy and confident, so a longer text feels grounded rather than stiff.
gen-almendra-display-gf-abyssinica-sil: Abyssinica SIL brings a classic literary tone, with a quiet shift in line weight and a tall middle zone in each word. Almendra Display adds ornate, open flourish up top.
gen-almendra-display-gf-cambo: Cambo is refined and bookish, with short capitals. Almendra Display's ornate heading leads into it, and a longer passage settles into a modest, steady thick-and-thin rhythm.
gen-almendra-display-gf-fanwood-text: Fanwood Text has a large-eyed lowercase and gentle swelling on its curves, a bookish serif through and through. Almendra Display sets the ornate tone above, and Fanwood Text carries the literary mood down the page.
gen-almendra-display-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Open meets shut. Almendra Display keeps its letters wide and ornate, while Holtwood One SC, a classic serif with wide tracking and a towering lowercase, closes its curves down to slivers for an authoritative contrast.
